local_base_change.model: x=t^e on N and x=s^2 on C0; normalize t^e=s^2
local_base_change.consequence_of_Y_to_C0_etale: e is 1 or 2 over each of the six branch values, and N->X4 has no ramification away from those six values

six_cusp_profile.notation: at cusp i, b_i is number of e=2 points and a_i is number of e=1 points
six_cusp_profile.bounds: 0 <= b_i <= 52 and a_i=105-2*b_i is positive odd
six_cusp_profile.meaning: the 210 branch points of Y->N are exactly the e=1 preimages of the six quotient cusps; this does not identify exceptional contact multiplicity with N->X4 ramification

orbifold_formulation.C0_subgroup: index-2 torsion-free subgroup given by the hyperelliptic double cover
orbifold_formulation.connectedness_note: since the N-cover degree 105 is odd, its subgroup cannot lie inside the index-2 C0 subgroup; the normalized fiber product is connected, consistently giving Y->C0 degree 105

explicit_abstract_witness.points: (r,j) with r in {0,1,2}, j in Z/35Z; total 105
explicit_abstract_witness.interpretation: an exact transitive branch-cycle tuple satisfying the first-projection orbifold/Riemann-Hurwitz constraints exists; by the complex Riemann existence correspondence it gives an abstract algebraic cover, but it is not attached to the fixed V6 carrier

diagnostic_verdict.next_useful_constraint: consume carrier-specific marking/contact/simultaneous-second-projection data; do not search arbitrary degree-105 etale covers as if first projection alone could exclude O210
